verdict.rationale: The first-party docs name an official Agent SDK that lets developers build their own agents on Claude Code's tools, with control over orchestration, tool access and permissions, so the product itself provides an SDK to build against. The evidence is a single overview sentence, with no detail on languages, installation, API reference or examples, and nothing independent shows people building with it. Missing for 10: supported SDK languages/packages, API reference or quickstart documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: the Agent SDK lets you build your own agents powered by Claude Code's tools and capabilities, with full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions.
